symptoms: Brown spots with concentric rings (bullseye pattern), yellowing around spots, defoliation starting from lower leaves
favorable_conditions: Warm weather 65-85°F, leaf wetness, high humidity
management_cultural: Crop rotation, remove plant debris, mulch soil, stake plants, remove lower leaves for airflow, avoid overhead irrigation
management_chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, copper-based fungicides, apply preventatively every 7-10 days
prevention: Use disease-free seeds, ensure good air circulation, water at base of plants

symptoms: Dark irregular spots with pale halo, white downy growth on leaf undersides, rapid wilting, dark firm lesions on fruits
favorable_conditions: Cool damp humid conditions, wet weather, temperatures 50-70°F
management_cultural: Remove infected plants immediately, destroy debris, avoid overhead watering, increase spacing
management_chemical: Copper-based fungicides, chlorothalonil, mancozeb, apply before symptoms appear
management_biological: Limited biological options, preventative approach critical
prevention: Plant in well-drained areas, monitor weather conditions, remove volunteers

symptoms: Small circular spots (1/4 inch) with tan/gray centers and dark borders, spots merge causing leaf destruction
favorable_conditions: High humidity, long leaf wetness periods, dense foliage, warm temperatures
management_cultural: Crop rotation, remove infected leaves, mulch to prevent soil splash, increase plant spacing, stake plants
management_chemical: Copper fungicides, chlorothalonil, preventative sprays when canopy closes
prevention: Remove plant debris, avoid working with wet plants, use pathogen-free seeds
resistance_varieties: Limited resistance in heirlooms, some hybrids resistant

biological_name: Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria, X. euvesicatoria
symptoms: Small water-soaked spots (1/16 inch), center may fall out, spots on leaves and fruits
favorable_conditions: Warm wet conditions, water splash, wounds in plant tissue
management_cultural: Use pathogen-free seeds, hot water seed treatment at 50°C, crop rotation, avoid overhead irrigation, remove infected plants
management_chemical: Copper-based bactericides, streptomycin (limited use)
management_biological: Bacillus subtilis, Pseudomonas fluorescens, Trichoderma viride
prevention: Plant windbreaks to reduce bacterial spread, handle plants when dry

symptoms: Olive-green to brown spots on leaves, velvety appearance, fruit lesions causing deformation, premature leaf drop
favorable_conditions: Wet springs, rain, high humidity, moderate temperatures 55-75°F

prevention: Sanitation of fallen debris, plant in well-ventilated areas
resistance_varieties: Liberty, Enterprise, Freedom, Williams Pride resistant varieties

symptoms: Yellow spots on upper leaf surface, orange gelatinous structures on lower surface, fruit lesions reducing quality
favorable_conditions: Wet weather in spring, proximity to juniper hosts (alternate host required)
management_cultural: Remove nearby junipers within 1 mile radius, increase air circulation
management_chemical: Myclobutanil, fenarimol, mancozeb, apply during spore release period
prevention: Plant away from junipers, select resistant cultivars
resistance_varieties: Redfree, Liberty, Williams Pride, Freedom are immune

symptoms: Shoot tips turn brown/black and curl (shepherd's crook), oozing cankers, blossoms wilt and turn brown, rapid progression

symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves/shoots/buds, stunted growth, curled leaves, reduced fruit set

management_cultural: Prune infected shoots, remove mummified fruits, improve air circulation
management_chemical: Myclobutanil, sulfur fungicides, potassium bicarbonate, spray before pink bud stage
prevention: Start treatments early in season, continue in dry weather, 18+ applications may be needed
resistance_varieties: Some resistant varieties, many crabapples have resistance

symptoms: Brown lesions with concentric rings on leaves, tuber lesions dark and sunken
favorable_conditions: Alternating wet and dry periods, warm temperatures, stressed plants
management_cultural: Crop rotation (3-4 years), hilling to protect tubers, remove volunteer plants, destroy crop residue
management_chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, copper fungicides, apply when conditions favor disease
prevention: Use certified seed potatoes, maintain plant vigor, avoid plant stress

symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves, white downy growth on undersides, brown tuber rot, rapid plant death

management_chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, copper fungicides, cymoxanil, apply preventatively
prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed, avoid overhead irrigation, monitor weather forecasts

symptoms: Circular tan lesions on leaves with dark borders, fruit mummies (shriveled berries), young fruit most susceptible

symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves/shoots/berries, stunted growth, cracked berries, off-flavors in wine
favorable_conditions: Moderate temperatures 68-80°F, shade, high humidity (no free water needed)
management_cultural: Prune for sunlight penetration, remove infected shoots, canopy management for airflow
management_chemical: Sulfur, myclobutanil, potassium bicarbonate, horticultural oils

symptoms: Yellow oil spots on upper leaf surface, white downy growth underneath, leaf drop, berry rot
favorable_conditions: Wet weather, rain, high humidity, temperatures 59-77°F, darkness for sporulation
management_cultural: Remove infected leaves, improve air drainage, avoid overhead irrigation
management_chemical: Mancozeb, copper fungicides, phosphorous acid, apply before rain events

resistance_varieties: European varieties more susceptible than American

symptoms: Small elongated reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces, severe infections cause yellowing and death

symptoms: Long cigar-shaped gray-green to tan lesions on leaves, lesions can be 6 inches long

prevention: Remove crop debris, use resistant hybrids

symptoms: Rectangular gray to tan lesions bounded by leaf veins, severe infections cause premature death

prevention: Bury crop residue, plant resistant hybrids, crop rotation

symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins, yellowing, wilting of leaves, systemic infection causing kresek
favorable_conditions: High humidity, warm temperatures 77-86°F, wounds from wind/insects, flooded conditions

prevention: Resistant varieties primary control, field sanitation

symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with gray centers and brown margins, neck rot at panicle base, complete crop loss possible

prevention: Use certified seeds, resistant varieties, proper water management
resistance_varieties: Resistant varieties available but pathogen evolves

symptoms: Small circular to oval orange-brown pustules on leaves, severe infections reduce yield and quality
favorable_conditions: Moderate temperatures 59-72°F, frequent dew, high humidity

prevention: Plant resistant varieties, monitor disease forecasts
resistance_varieties: Resistant varieties available but rust evolves

symptoms: Yellow-orange pustules in stripes along leaf veins, can severely reduce yield
favorable_conditions: Cool temperatures 50-65°F, frequent moisture, high humidity

symptoms: Blotchy mottling on leaves, yellow shoots, lopsided bitter fruits, tree decline and death

symptoms: Raised corky lesions on leaves/fruits/twigs, yellow halos around lesions, premature fruit drop, defoliation

management_chemical: Copper-based bactericides preventatively, especially before rain

resistance_varieties: Resistant species exist but commercial varieties susceptible

symptoms: Dark sunken lesions on pods/stems/leaves, black veins in pods, seed infection causes damping-off

management_cultural: Use disease-free certified seeds, crop rotation (2-3 years), avoid working in wet fields, destroy infected residue
management_chemical: Copper fungicides, chlorothalonil, apply preventatively
prevention: Plant in well-drained soil, avoid overhead watering, use resistant varieties

symptoms: Water-soaked lesions that turn brown, yellow halos, systemic infection in severe cases
favorable_conditions: Warm humid weather, water splash, contaminated seeds, temperatures 82-86°F
management_cultural: Use certified disease-free seeds, crop rotation, avoid overhead irrigation, handle when dry

symptoms: Angular yellow spots on upper leaf surface bounded by veins, purple-gray growth on undersides, rapid defoliation

symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves/stems, yellowing, stunted growth, reduced fruit quality

management_chemical: Sulfur, potassium bicarbonate, horticultural oils, myclobutanil
prevention: Plant resistant varieties, ensure good air flow, monitor regularly

biological_name: Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria, X. euvesicatoria
symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves, raised corky spots on fruits, defoliation, reduced yield

symptoms: Purple to brown spots on leaves, spots enlarge and merge, leaves turn brown and scorch, reduced runner production

symptoms: Small circular gray spots with reddish-brown margins, spots may have frog eye appearance with gray centers

symptoms: Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves, black arm symptoms on stems, boll rot in severe cases

symptoms: Angular yellow lesions on upper surface, white sporulation on undersides, stunted growth
favorable_conditions: Cool moist conditions 59-68°F, high humidity, overhead irrigation

management_chemical: Phosphorous acid, mancozeb, copper fungicides, apply preventatively
prevention: Use resistant varieties, proper spacing, greenhouse production

symptoms: V-shaped yellow lesions from leaf margins, black veins, systemic infection causes head rot

management_cultural: Hot water seed treatment (122°F for 20 minutes), crop rotation (2-3 years), remove crop debris, control insects

symptoms: Blossom blight, twig cankers, fruit rot with concentric rings of spores, mummified fruits

symptoms: Dark brown lesions on leaves, yellowing, defoliation, reduced root quality

prevention: Use disease-free seeds, hot water treatment, proper field drainage

symptoms: Orange-brown pustules on lower leaf surface, yellowing of upper surface, premature defoliation

symptoms: Small circular dark brown spots on upper leaf surface, yellow halos, defoliation, reduced yield and quality
